newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open little changed.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were called to open little changed Thursday in line with LME copper after a smaller-than-expected rise in LME warehouse copper stocks.
COMEX September copper was called unchanged to up 0.20 cent from Wednesday's close of 105.90 cents a lb after trading from 106.00 to 106.50 cents on ACCESS.
LME copper stocks rose a further 850 tonnes Thursday to 227,800 tonnes, while COMEX copper stocks rose 233 short tons to 30,023 short tons, as the seasonally slow summer still stifles demand.
In the past six weeks, LME warehouse stocks have increased 105,400 tonnes, taking the total to the highest level since October last year.
Copper prices recovered in the past two weeks from three-month lows set in early July in the wake of a rally to 12-month highs.
